title: AURORA-AI, the Cordova scoreboard
one_line_look: A wet October night on Prince William Sound, lit by two light sources that are arguing: the sodium amber of what actually burned, and the cold cyan of what was claimed.

palette.mood: Coastal rainforest dark, saturated and wet rather than gloomy. Amber is warm, local, physical and ALWAYS means measured. Cyan is cold, self-lit, weightless and ALWAYS means claimed. A viewer who never hears a word should still learn that rule by 30 seconds, because the whole film is an argument between those two colours.
palette.why_this_story: Cordova sits in coastal temperate rainforest on the Sound, the project starts on October 1st, and the physical stake is a diesel flame against falling water. The colour opposition is not decoration, it is the thesis: amber is the gauge, cyan is the forecast, and the film is about whether anyone ever puts them side by side.
palette.divergence: Hard break from both recent dispatches. 2026-09-13 was a warm bright PAPER interior (cream #F4EADF, copper #C7805D, petrol #27615B). 2026-09-14 was a bright blue-and-white LAB (off-white #EFF5E9, blue #254D98, mango #F7AE38, mint #93DFC6). Both were light-field films on pale grounds. This one is a DARK, wet, high-saturation exterior night, which neither of the last two has been, and the ground value is the darkest this channel has shipped in a month.

light.time_of_day: October dusk into night, rain just stopped, everything sheened.
light.key: Low warm sodium key from screen-left, motivated by the powerhouse door standing open. It rakes across wet surfaces so every horizontal reads as reflective, which is how the frame stays modulated without adding props.
light.fill: Cold blue-green ambient bounce from the wet sky, very low, so shadow sides never go to flat black.
light.rim: Rain-sheen rim on every solid form, from the key side. On the hero it is the single strongest read of dimension in a dark frame.
light.the_cyan_rule: The forecast cyan is SELF-LIT and never reaches another object. No cyan bounce, no cyan rim on a real thing, no cyan cast shadow. This is lib/simulation.tsx and lib/forecast.tsx clause 4 enforced in the lighting plan, and it is the mechanism by which a viewer can always tell which half of the frame is real.
light.depth: stage3d planes, three deep in every exterior shot: far fjord wall and ridge at z 650 with aerial haze, the powerhouse and creek at z 0, and rain plus a foreground rail or alder at z -170 catching the key. Depth comes from the plane separation and the haze gradient, never from a drop shadow.

shape_language.grammar: CURVES YOU CANNOT COMMAND against BOXES YOU CAN.
shape_language.soft_organic: The creek, the penstock's bend, the rain, the ridge line, and Sourdough himself, who is warm and rounded by design. These are the things that do what they do regardless of what anyone decides.
shape_language.hard_rectilinear: The diesel gen-set, the CLAIMED and MEASURED slots, and the data center's two refrigerator boxes. These are things a person chose.
shape_language.why_this_story: The film's question is what a forecast can and cannot buy. A river is a curve nobody dispatches; a generator is a box somebody starts. Every frame puts one against the other, and the Act 4 turn is the moment a NEW box arrives beside the curve and the argument changes shape.
shape_language.deliberate_contrast_not_default: Sourdough's warm roundness is already the shelf's opposite to ServerMachine's cold rectilinearity, and this run uses that pairing at a deliberately absurd scale ratio rather than the usual one.

casting.hero: Sourdough — the personified power plant, cast as the islanded grid itself. Warm, rounded, proud, and GUESSING. His furnace-window chest glow is the film's second gauge: it is the amber, and it dims at the turn. Hero-rerun gate clear: the last two heroes were GearLever (09-14) and PenAndDocument (09-13), and Sourdough has not led.
casting.ai_presence: THE FORECAST DOUBLE, drawn with this run's net-new lib/forecast.tsx grammar plus lib/simulation.tsx's Simulated for the twin's silhouette. Not a robot, not a server box, not a brain. The AI in this story is literally a virtual replica of Sourdough that runs slightly ahead of him, and drawing it as anything else would be the stretch the angle room refused.
supporting: Character — the co-op operator, outfit 'worker', the person who has to decide whether to start the diesel. Present in the shots where a DECISION is being made, and absent where nothing is being decided, per Gate 0A''.

ServerMachine — Act 4 only, tint steel, at roughly one fifth its usual staging scale. The channel has drawn this rig as a looming institutional appetite; here it arrives as a polite little box the size of two refrigerators, and the scale reversal IS the beat.
Cell — not cast. Cordova's hedge is diesel and water, not batteries, and putting a battery in frame would be a fact the sources do not support.
casting.net_new: RunOfRiver — the intake, penstock and powerhouse of a run-of-river hydro plant, as a reusable set piece. This is a real shelf gap: the library has OilfieldBG, FrostYardBG and RiverBG but nothing that shows water being TAKEN from a creek and turned into power, which is the physical mechanism this entire film rests on. Params: flow 0..1 (the creek's water level, which is the thing nobody commands), gate 0..1 (the intake), and spill 0..1 (the energy a run-of-river plant throws away because it cannot store it, which is the Act 4 setup).

motion_language.always_running: WATER NEVER STOPS. Every shot containing the creek carries a continuous flow animation that spans the entire hold, plus rain on an irrational period, plus Sourdough's breath. This is DISPATCH_STANDARD section 8's 'no scene built only out of interpolate() events' satisfied by the setting itself rather than by a push alone.
motion_language.camera: Every shot also carries the mandatory slow push (1.00 to about 1.08) and a lateral drift on an irrational period. Composed stage3d CameraMoves per shot; no static frames.
hero_moves_that_earn_blur_and_overshoot: THE NEEDLE SLAM. The diesel gauge needle does not drift, it jumps and settles, with anticipation below zero and a visible overshoot. It is the film's heartbeat and it fires on the emphasis words.
THE TWIN ASSEMBLING. The forecast double builds itself out of the data, drawn (lib/simulation `drawn`) from the ground up, hunting before it settles.
THE CONE OPENING. The uncertainty cone unfurls forward from NOW, widening, and the widening is the motion rather than a held shape.
THE EMPTY SLOT. Act 3's key image does not animate IN so much as refuse to fill: the hatching crawls, the slot stays empty, and the stillness is the point. Deliberate stillness is acting.
THE BOX SETTLING. Act 4's data center lands beside the creek with a small, polite squash and settle, which is funnier and more honest than a slam.
motion_language.no_linear_anything: Every entrance uses lib/motion entrance() with anticipation, overshoot and settle; everything attached gets followThrough(); MotionBlur is fed from the same velocity that drives the move.

composition.approach: The 9:16 master is the graded cut and is composed for. Content above y 420 and below y 1500 stages the vertical and never appears in the square: the fjord wall and rain above, the wet foreground rail and alder below. The story itself stays inside the centred 1:1 safe box.
composition.focal_hierarchy: In a dark frame the brightest thing is the subject, so amber is rationed. One amber source per shot at full value, everything else stepped down. The cyan is allowed to be bright because it is self-lit, which is how the two can share a frame without competing.
composition.negative_space_beats: Act 3 earns its silence with the most empty frame in the film, and it is empty ON PURPOSE around a hatched box. Dead-space meter will read high there and that is the correct reading, not a defect to fix.
composition.signature_shot: THE PAIR. The CLAIMED slot lit cyan with a number in it, the MEASURED slot beside it standing empty and hatched, and Sourdough between them looking at the empty one while the creek keeps running behind him. One frame that contains the award, the honest state of it, and the thing that will settle it.
composition.brand_mark: One anchor, top-left, off the hero, off the slots, off the creek line. Does not move between shots.

craft_advance.system: lib/forecast.tsx — THE FORECAST GRAMMAR (net-new this run, tsc clean).
craft_advance.what_it_adds: simulation.tsx owns 'how do you draw a model of a thing'. This owns 'how do you draw a claim about a TIME, and that claim being checked'. ForecastTrace always draws NOW, always widens uncertainty with distance, and never casts a shadow. Reconcile is the honest half: a CLAIMED slot and a MEASURED slot, with settled starting at 0, where MEASURED renders as an EMPTY HATCHED BOX reading NOT YET MEASURED.
craft_advance.why_it_matters_beyond_this_run: This channel covers forecasts, models and projections constantly and has improvised the 'prediction versus outcome' picture every time. Making the empty MEASURED slot a required state means no future dispatch can draw a confident forecast without the component asking whether anyone checked it.

binding_note: This plan is an INPUT the build executes against, not a description written afterward. If a build decision contradicts it, either fix the build or consciously revise this file and say why in the retrospective.
